newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria sets key elections for August next year.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria sets key elections for August next year.

text.p: Nigeria's military government on Wednesday published a detailed revised time-table of its return to democracy programme, setting the key presidential and state governorship elections for August 1, 1998 .
The final hand over of power to an elected president remained October 1, 1998, the 38th anniversary of Nigeria's independence from Britain in 1960.

The governorship election, under which the governors of Nigeria's 36 states and the mayor of the federal capital Abuja would be chosen, was previously due to be held in the fourth quarter of this year.
"This amendment of the transition programme was not initiated by the military but by the political parties," said Mamman Nasir, chairman of the transition implementation
